name: Knowledge-Ops
description: Magic Unicorn governed evidence retrieval layer. Agents call knowledge.search / knowledge.ground; the service federates authorized stores, returns cited evidence excerpts, and labels automated grounding as heuristic rather than verified. Storage-opaque: agents never touch backing stores directly.

stdio.note: Local transport for Claude Desktop / Cursor (see KNOWLEDGE-OPS.md). The HTTPS endpoint is the broker-facing HTTP-MCP JSON-RPC surface.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Federated lexical+semantic search across all enabled sources. Returns merged, re-ranked, cited passages.

scope.description: Optional visibility filter. Omission derives visible knowledge from the verified identity; all requires knowledge-admin.

as_of.description: Optional ISO 8601 historical time. Historical retrieval is confined to the versioned wiki source.

tools.name: ground
tools.description: Triage a claim/question against the corpus. Returns cited excerpts plus an explicitly heuristic relation (possible_support, possible_contradiction, possible_conflict, related_evidence, or not_enough_evidence); it does not claim semantic verification.

query.description: The claim or question to ground.

as_of.description: Optional ISO 8601 historical time. Historical retrieval is confined to the versioned wiki source.

tools.name: list_sources
tools.description: List federated sources and whether each is enabled/configured/disabled.

tools.name: get_doc
tools.description: Fetch a single wiki document by id or path.

tools.name: list_docs
tools.description: List wiki documents (id, path, title, scope, owner, updated_at).

tools.name: doc_history
tools.description: Version history for a wiki document.

tools.name: find_file
tools.description: Search the indexed file corpus and return best-matching files/chunks.

tools.name: deep_read
tools.description: Read all indexed chunks for a single file path, ordered/relevance-ranked.

tools.name: upsert_doc
tools.description: Create or update a wiki document (versioned).

scope.description: Personal ownership is derived from token sub. Global requires write:knowledge:global.

metadata.description: Source metadata; project documents must include workspace_id and may include project_id.

tools.name: inspect_citation
tools.description: Inspect the authorized, content-bound source span behind a wiki or file-index citation.

tools.name: delete_doc
tools.description: Create a governed tombstone and purge all local projections. Global deletion requires knowledge-admin.

tools.name: record_metric
tools.description: Record a named timeseries metric value with tags.

tools.name: graph
tools.description: The constellation graph the Observatory UI renders: sampled nodes plus semantic and wiki-link edges across enabled stores, visibility-filtered for the calling principal. Same payload as GET /kb.graph.

scope.description: Optional visibility filter: global|personal|all|workspace:<id>. Omission derives visible knowledge from the verified identity; all requires knowledge-admin.

limit_per_coll.description: Node sample size per collection (clamped to 1-200).

tools.name: links
tools.description: The wiki-link index: resolved doc-to-doc links, missing red-link targets, and orphan docs for the caller-visible wiki slice. Same payload as GET /kb.links.

tools.name: stats
tools.description: Per-source record counts across the federated stores (semantic collections, wiki, file index, metrics, graph stores). Same payload as GET /kb.stats.

tools.name: whoami
tools.description: The calling principal's verified identity: name, sorted scopes, and is_admin. Needs no scope — any authenticated principal may introspect itself. Same payload as GET /kb.me.
